notes: ACCESS: Direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered. robots.txt (https://jysk.dk/robots.txt) checked first: only disallows /customer/, /checkout/, /b2b/, *filters=*, *sort=*, /search for User-agent: * -- no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai-specific rule found, so no Rule-3 opt-out applies. Site is a live, active Next.js (App Router/RSC) storefront, not retired. COUNT METHOD: each category page's server-rendered HTML embeds an RSC payload containing filters.filteredarticles (a product-ID array used for facet computation) plus a JSON-LD ItemList with numberOfItems, plus literal rendered product-card DOM elements (data-testid=product-card-title id=<productId>-...). On most pages all three agree exactly (used as the qty). On 2 categories (Outdoor Lamps & Lanterns, Garden Pots & Planters) filteredarticles differed by 1 from numberOfItems/rendered-cards; verified by diffing the ID sets that the discrepant ID belongs to a hidden/non-rendered article not offered in the listing, so numberOfItems==rendered_cards (the two independent, mutually-agreeing signals) was used as ground truth over the facet-pool array -- consistent with the brief's warning that structured backend counts can be inflated. Cross-checked the Dekoration parent (211) exactly reconciles as 143 (8 in-scope children) + 68 (4 excluded children: Duftlys/scented candles=10, Kunstige blomster/artificial flowers=17, Kunstige planter/artificial plants=18, Lys og servietter/candles+napkins mixed=23), full exhaustion confirmed. LANGUAGE: first Danish-market company in the project; all sub_category names translated from the site's own Danish UI text (Belysning=Lighting, Spejle=Mirrors, Vaser=Vases, Lysestager=Candle Holders, Ure=Clocks, Billedrammer=Picture Frames, Urtepotter/Havekrukker=Flower Pots & Planters/Garden Pots & Planters, etc). EXCLUDED (product-type grounds, not room words): Home Fragrance -- Duftlys (scented candles/fragrance oils) and Lys og servietter (candles bundled inseparably with paper napkins in one flat listing, dropped whole node per 'take unscented children only where they exist as their own listing'); Kunstige blomster/Kunstige planter (artificial flowers/plants, indoor and outdoor variants both excluded); Kokkentilbehor (kitchen accessories -- cutting boards, salt/pepper mills, paper-towel holders, storage jars: functional kitchen tools); Husholdning's 3 children (cleaning cloths/sponges, cleaning products, reusable shopping totes -- all functional); Badevaerelsestilbehor (155 items -- toilet brushes, soap dispensers, toothbrush holders, room-spray diffusers, hooks, baskets: genuinely functional bathroom/hygiene hardware under Rule 0.4, only a handful of incidental jewelry-bowl items, not enough to redeem a heavily functional mixed rollup); Havedekoration (garden decor, 15 items -- excluded as a mixed rollup: ~9 genuinely decorative (fountain, birdbath, garden statue, plant pedestals, self-watering pot) vs ~6 furniture/hardscape (folding tables, rolling carts, a stool, 2 terrace-tile sets), no separate URL to split them, dropped per 'mixed roll-ups: drop them, don't pad'); Kunstige udendoersplanter and garden-furniture covers under Havetilbehor (artificial plants / functional covers). Standard project-wide exclusions also applied: all textiles (rugs/dormats/throws/cushions/chair pads/table textiles/tea towels/towels/bathrobes/bedding/curtains), all furniture in every room (bedroom/living/dining/office/entryway/storage/garden), pet supplies, children's furniture/items, laundry & ironing, LED bulbs and batteries (Belysning's LED-paerer and Batterier children). RULE 0 GAINS: fully explored the Have (Garden/Outdoor) branch specifically because Rule 0 forbids skipping on the room word 'Have' -- found and included the dedicated Udendoers belysning (Outdoor Lighting) node with 2 children, Outdoor Lamps & Lanterns (15) and Solar Lamps (12) = 27 outdoor lighting products, which a room-blind pass would likely have missed entirely by assuming 'Garden' meant furniture-only. Also deliberately opened Badevaerelse (Bathroom) and checked its sole product-adjacent node rather than skipping it on the room word alone -- it was excluded on genuine product-type grounds (functional hygiene hardware), not because it said 'Bathroom'. Checked all other room top-nav pages (Soveværelse/bedroom, Stue/living room, Spisestue/dining room, Kontor/office, Entré/entryway, Opbevaring/storage, Gardiner/curtains) for hidden lighting/mirror sub-nodes per Rule 0.1/0.3 -- none exist; JYSK centralises indoor lighting and mirrors solely under Indretning (Interior) > Belysning/Spejle, with the single exception of the Have > Udendoers belysning branch, which is included above. No duplicate-company concern for S.N. 146 (first JYSK entry in this project, no prior c<SR>.json to compare against).
